sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-12,800 (levels 1-20). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Killing Blow T3. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Express Shot, vitality 4.8k at Dispel Magic.

items.name: Restorative Shot
items.caption: Temporary, sold when you buy Lucky Shot later.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Express Shot completes 4.8k weapon in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Close Quarters
items.caption: Temporary, sold when you buy Inhibitor later.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Express Shot completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Mystic Regeneration
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Bullet Resist Shredder, 12000 souls (~12.0 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Express Shot completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Express Shot completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Express Shot
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of High-Velocity Rounds (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Battle Vest
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Dispel Magic, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Radiant Regeneration
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Bullet Resist Shredder, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus. Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 12,800-30,400 (levels 20-30). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Serrated Knives T3, Bloodletting T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Slice and Dice, impact damage) grows from 123 to 159. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Bullet Resist Shredder.

items.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Your knives apply it, so land a knife before you shoot.

items.name: Hunter's Aura
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Fleetfoot
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: swap_candidate)

items.name: Bullet Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Berserker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 12,800 to 18,400 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Silencer
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 18,400 to 24,800 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Dispel Magic? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Fleetfoot.
sections.desc: Dying after Dispel Magic? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Fleetfoot.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry melts you when you dash in.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hurting you after the hit, like Infernus burn or Seven's ult.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Serrated Knives (channelled) and Slice and Dice (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep catching you before you can dash.

items.name: Glass Cannon
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 24,000 to 30,400 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Colossus
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Replaces Dispel Magic: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
